description.narrative: The YAS project (Youth in Agribusiness: Enabling scaling of innovative technologies for sustainable food solutions) is supported by the Embassy of Kingdom of Netherlands, and was designed to support youths aged 18 to 35 to create viable agribusiness enterprises using innovative climate-smart technologies and business practices that boost productivity and increase their income. The project targets 10,000 youths in four Nigerian states (FCT, Oyo, Ogun, and Kano) to start new businesses and/or increase their income. The three-year project was commissioned in 2022.

The goal of this project is to create viable and sustainable employment opportunities in agrifood-systems in Nigeria. The project will identify existing gaps in the sector and empower beneficiaries to provide solutions that would be economically rewarding to the sector and to potential Agripreneurs.
